note: PROBATION IS A PERIOD WITH AN END DATE, and confirmation is an EVENT on the employee timeline. SmartPRS 2's ProbationService (F7/F6) derives the end from doj + a default number of months unless the employee carries an override, confirms by clearing a flag, extends by moving the date, and nudges HR and the manager at milestones. The numbers below are its defaults, declared; a tenant changes them from the screen and the change is versioned.
settings_module_note: WHERE THE SETTINGS ARE EDITED (owner, 23 Sep): on Organization Configuration -> Companies, one box per company, because probation is a company's rule and a group running three companies runs three policies. Named here rather than compared as a literal in public/app.php, so the module that carries the section is a declaration and not a string buried in a template.
statutory_during_probation_note: WHICH STATUTORY HEADS APPLY WHILE AN EMPLOYEE IS ON PROBATION (owner, 8 Oct): by default none — PF, ESIC, PT, LWF and TDS are not considered during probation. A tenant changes the default on People -> Probation, and each company can choose its own on Organization Configuration -> Companies. true = applicable during probation. Heads are config/statutory-applicability.json's.
probation_types_note: THE DIRECTORY'S "Employee Type" VALUES THAT MEAN PROBATION (owner, 28 Sep). The board used to read only employment_stage, so somebody added on the Directory as Probationary never appeared on it. Either field now puts an employee on the board.
confirmed_note: WHAT CONFIRMATION WRITES (owner, 28 Sep: "the Employment stage or status ... should be updated in the Directory for the relevant employee as Permanent"): both employment_stage and employment_type, so neither column keeps saying probation.
notify_roles_note: WHO IS TOLD WHEN A PROBATION IS ENDING (owner, 28 Sep: "the Admin and HR Admins get notifications in their logins according to the interval set"). Roles, not people: every login holding one sees the reminder on Notifications and the top-bar bell. The shipped default only — the tenant picks its own on the Probation screen. A company's "tell HR" switch still decides whether its employees' reminders go to these roles at all.
events_note: probation_events is the ported table; action is confirm or extend. Confirmation ALSO lands on employment_events through Surface\Timeline, so payroll's statutory applicability and the F&F both read one fact.
reminders_note: Reminders are queued through Surface\Notifications (events probation.reminder / probation.overdue / probation.confirmed in config/notifications.d/people.json) once per employee per milestone — the dedupe key is code:milestone — so a sweep that runs twice sends once. `hr_recipient` is the recipient code HR messages are queued under.
hr_recipient_note: RETIRED 28 Sep: no login holds the code "hr", so every reminder queued to it reached nobody. Reminders now go to notify_roles.
